items.name: Timbó ao Cubo 2025

venue.name: [CIC de Timbó](https://www.culturatimbo.com.br/a-fundacao/cic)
venue.address: Av. Sete de Setembro, 414 - Centro, Timbó - SC, 89120-000

items.information:
🇧🇷 Bem-vindos ao Primeiro Timbó ao Cubo Open

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo.https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'.

Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para o evento 3x3x3.

🇬🇧 Welcome to the first Timbó ao Cubo Open


Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at this video.
https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8

Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event.

On-site registration will only be avaible for the 3x3x3 cube event.

items.name: Nub Open Mission Viejo Spring 2025
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NubOpenMissionViejoSpring2025#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

This competition is in partnership with Team Nub, [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
